title: Gather a folder
folderTip: A folder below /mnt/user. Its content can be spread over several disks, which the user share does not show.
taskTip: Gather brings everything onto one disk, so only that one wakes up for playback. Empty spreads the part on one disk over the others, for example before you swap it.
targetTip: Suggested is the disk that has to copy the least and has enough room.
sourceTip: Only disks that hold part of this folder.
already: The folder lies on {disk} completely already.
nothing: Nothing of this folder lies on the array.
noRoom: The other disks lack room for {size}.
spreads: Spreads {size} from {disk} over {to}. Whole subfolders stay together.
cachedOne: 1 file is still on the cache, the mover takes care of it.
cachedMany: {n} files are still on the cache, the mover takes care of them.
background: Runs as a job in the background
